implementation_gaps: No runtime enforcement yet consumes this registry as the authority source.
ActionCandidate.consequence is metadata rather than a hard execution gate.
ActionCandidate.reversible is metadata/ranking input rather than an explicit irreversible-action stop/escalation gate.
ActionCandidate.evidence_ready is not a hard eligibility condition.
Risk is persisted and reviewed but is not yet a dedicated pre-execution hard gate.
Stopping conditions are defined in governance but not yet represented as a first-class runtime decision state.
Responsible value is defined constitutionally and in quality/value documents but is not yet a single machine-checkable pre-execution decision function.
